arguments.sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."SRC_CD", h."MEMO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by 1,2,3,4 having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", i."STAT_CD", (select sum("CR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') cr2000, (select sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000') dr2000 from "APINVH" i where abs(i."INV_AMT") <> coalesce((select sum("CR_AMT")-sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),-1) and abs(i."INV_AMT") <> coalesce((select sum("CR_AMT")-sum("DR_AMT") from "GLJRNL" l where l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" and trim(l."ACCT_CD")='2000'),-1)*-1

select "INV_ID","VEND_CD","INV_NO","INV_DT","INV_AMT","JRNL_NO", upper(regexp_replace(trim("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')) v, ltrim(upper(regexp_replace("INV_NO",'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')),'0') n, count(*) over (partition by upper(regexp_replace(trim("VEND_CD"),'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')), ltrim(upper(regexp_replace("INV_NO",'[^A-Za-z0-9]','','g')),'0')) c from "APINVH" order by c desc limit 20

select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STAT_CD", p."CLOSE_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."MEMO" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."POST_DT" not between p."STRT_DT" and p."END_DT" or (p."CLOSE_DT" is not null and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT") or (p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."END_DT")
select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", c."ACTV_FLG" from "GLJRNL" l left join "GLCOA" c on c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" where c."ACCT_CD" is null or c."ACTV_FLG"<>'Y'
